pages.text: Apotheosis overhauled enchanting, spawners, potions, and village trades. It is active from Tier 1.

$(bold)Enchanting overhaul:$(/bold) All enchanted books removed from structure loot. Bookshelf tiers determine your enchantment pool. The 'Too Expensive' anvil cap is removed.$(br2)$(bold)Gem sockets:$(/bold) Affix items have gem sockets. Gems scale from Flawed (T1) to Perfect (T4). The Gem Cutting Table is T2-gated.

$(bold)Affix system:$(/bold) Random stat rolls on weapons and armor from Common (T1) to Mythic (endgame). Reforging Station lets you reroll affixes using tokens.$(br2)$(bold)Spawner overhaul:$(/bold) Apotheosis spawners can be modified with upgrades (speed, range, spawn caps). Farming spawners is a valid progression strategy.
